english.title: Assisting offender ( murder only )
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, did and act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), with intent to impede the apprehension or prosecution of

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY NAME..)]_
(B)_[a person]_

who had committed the offence of murder, knowing or believing

(C)_[him]_
(D)_[her]_
(E)_[the said person]_

to be guilty of the offence or some other offence which carries a term of imprisonment of 5 years or more
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4(1) and (3) of the Criminal Law Act 1967.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required.
(ii) See also offence wordings H2019 for other indictable offences and H2018 for triable either way offences.

other.powersofarrest:
Arrest without warrant

IMPORTANT:
The powers of arrest for offences under section 4(1) require that the offences to which they relate must carry a sentenced fixed by law or one in which a first time offender aged 18 or over could be sentenced to 5 years or more imprisonment.
other.penalty:
Ten years imprisonment.
